reuse.why: Reuses NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES, setBudget, getSheetValue and batchMessages, but the category-selection query and income filter are copied rather than extracted into a shared selection for month-wide actions.

duplication.why: Adds a fifth verbatim copy of the bulk-editable category query plus the income skip and expense sign flip from set3MonthAvg.

placement.why: The action sits beside the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts with the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapping.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Easy to read and consistent with its neighbours, but any future change to which categories month-wide actions fill now needs five identical edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection abstraction exists in this tree; the change follows the existing copy pattern.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied query and loop are verbatim, not reshaped.
